newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in September.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in September.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $131 million in the second half of September to $5.175 from $5.044 billion, according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet.
Gross reserves, which include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank, had gone up by $20 million in the first half of September.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves which stood at $2.858 billion at year-end but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $3.6 billion at the end of September.
